source: Actual cameraColorBuffer, cameraDepthBuffer, cameraNormalBuffer from HDRP CustomPassContext
color: EXR: raw pre-postprocess camera HDR RGB (includes HDRP exposure convention). PNG: diagnostic Reinhard plus linear-to-sRGB; use normal screenshot for final graded color.
depth: EXR RGB: LinearEyeDepth in metres. PNG: clamp(depth / display range). Includes actual depth-writing geometry; transparent non-depth writers are absent.
normal: EXR RGB: world-space normal decoded from HDRP normal buffer. PNG: normal * 0.5 + 0.5; no-geometry pixels black. Transparent objects may not write this buffer.
orientation: GPU readback row order without manual flip; compare with the companion screenshot when reviewing.
scope: Read-only buffers. CPU versions are renderer declarations. Actual optional shadow atlas/cubemap readbacks provide pixels, but do not prove per-piece shadow/reflection identity or complete absence. Pixel auditor validates selected main-camera depth/normal samples only.
declaredContractAudit: PASS: CPU renderer declaration only; GPU shadow/reflection not verified

pixelAudit.scope: Actual HDRP depth/normal readback versus current uploaded mesh ray intersections at sampled interior/near-edge pixels. Historical Empty silhouettes test selected stale-depth pixels. Other scene occluders are classified separately. A disagreement within 1/128 pixel of a projected triangle edge is NOT_VALIDATED_RASTER_BOUNDARY, never a passing normal/depth match; it bounds subpixel raster coverage ambiguity. This does not validate every pixel, final color, shadows, reflections, or temporal history.
pixelAudit.isolatedReadbackDepthMutation: PASS_DETECTED: FAIL_DEPTH_BEHIND_CURRENT_MESH; isolated CPU mutation of one actual GPU-readback depth pixel; no GPU render fault was injected; original pixels and baseline probes were preserved

reflection: Actual HDProbe.realtimeTexture; 128 px; mode=EveryFrame; timeSlicing=False; texture updateCount=268; position=(0.00, 1.05, 0.00)
shadow: Actual GPU _ShadowmapCascadeAtlas, point sampled over whole atlas at1024x1024. EXR R=device depth, G/B=native atlas width/height. PNG min/max-normalized. Contact shadows are not isolated. Per-piece identity/absence NOT_VALIDATED by atlas readback alone.
reflectionScope: Six actual realtime cubemap faces at mip0, sampled at native face resolution. This is a local spatial approximation; no pixel-level per-piece absence verdict. Face labels and sampler direction conventions are in capture shader. Configure EveryFrame/no time slicing; metadata records configuration, not a fabricated GPU section token.
